text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! El Condor Pasa really is 
the strongest in the world!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"You did it!! You really, truly gave it 
your all...!!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
(A dream—no, this is reality... I 
finally... finally did it—)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
(To become the sole champion of the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe, the goal I've 
strived for since childhood—...!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe—to me, it is 
no unachievable dream—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A means to prove I am the strongest in the 
world, and a goal I believed with 
certainty would one day come true.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"However, Japanese races and the 'Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe' are entirely different 
beasts—"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The turf quality, the shape of the track, 
the brutal undulations—everything is 
different.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"To truly win the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, I had to remake myself by any 
means necessary."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
“Still, bringing that to life on my own 
would take an impossible amount of 
time...”

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Just as I had braced myself for that, 
Project L'Arc came into being.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
choice_data_list: You proved it, the world's strongest...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
(They believed that becoming "the world's 
strongest" and winning the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe wasn't just a fantasy, and 
that El could really do it—)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
(The very first, irreplaceable member of 
"Team El.")
choice_data_list:
We can hold a victory party for Team 
El...!

We can hold a victory party for Team El, 
can't we...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno!! Let's celebrate grandly! 
Spectacularly! Infinitelyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
(To everyone, to you―― To express my 
gratitude to "Team El"...!)
